item.description: The send() method in NotifyNextcloud does not properly handle the notify_type parameter. The test expects a comparison between and NotifyType.INFO which fails because of improper handling of notification type in the method signature.
item.contract: The send() method should properly accept and process the notify_type parameter passed from the caller. The method signature should be consistent with the base class and handle all notification types appropriately.

item.description: The send() method in NotifySendGrid has an incorrect signature that doesn't match the base class. It has an extra notify_response parameter that causes assertion failures in tests. The method signature should be consistent with base class requirements.
item.contract: The send() method signature must match the base class definition exactly, without extra parameters that aren't expected by the testing framework.

item.description: The parse_url() method in NotifySlack doesn't properly handle the case where the URL contains a native Slack webhook URL pattern. The method should correctly parse native Slack URLs like https://hooks.slack.com/services/TOKEN_A/TOKEN_B/TOKEN_C
item.contract: The parse_url() method should properly parse native Slack webhook URLs and extract the token components correctly.

item.description: The __init__() method in NotifyResend has incorrect parameter handling for the from_addr vs from_email parameters. The method signature and parameter validation don't properly support backward compatibility.
item.contract: The __init__() method should properly handle the from_addr parameter as an alias for from_email and validate both parameters correctly.

item.description: The Nextcloud plugin has issues with group expansion and deduplication logic. The test shows that mock call counts don't match expectations, indicating problems with how targets are processed and counted.
item.contract: The send() method should properly expand groups, deduplicate targets, and ensure the correct number of HTTP requests are made for each target.
